newsitem.title: USA: Mylan and Meridian Medical in long-term alliance.
newsitem.headline: Mylan and Meridian Medical in long-term alliance.

text.p: Mylan Laboratories Inc said Tuesday it has has entered into a long-term strategic alliance with Meridian Medical Technologies Inc in which Meridian will license, manufacture and supply a line of generic injectible drugs to Mylan.
Meridian is a developer of auto-injector drug delivery systems.
Under the agreement, Myland said Meridian will develop and manufacture the drugs and grant to Mylan certain exclusive marketing rights.

The company said the first drugs covered by this agreement will compete in markets exceeding $150 million in 1996 sales and will be marketed by Mylan to physicians, hospitals, health maintenance organizations and managed care providers.
